citations.claim: Body 1 distance to wall surface increasingly negative showing penetration growth
Body 1 penetration exceeds 0.15 limit triggering no_wall_penetration

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.00068 to 0.0004 to reduce per-step penetration; smaller substeps prevent wall overlap exceeding tolerance

explanation: Body 1 with low restitution penetrates wall because positional correction / collision impulse is insufficient at this dt. Penetration deepens from -0.109 to -0.152 over steps 407-409 exceeding 0.15 tolerance. Smaller dt prevents this.
vision_note: The red body sits in contact with the tip of the grey wall from step 406 through 409 and appears to slightly overlap/penetrate the wall corner throughout, while the blue controller body remains at a distance. There is no large motion or tunneling visible; the red body stays lodged at the wall edge up to the violation at 409.
